## Privacy check

Do **not** paste:
- test addresses;
- business endpoint names;
- test cities/states/regions;
- coordinates;
- named roads/intersections/landmarks;
- identifiable real route maps or geometry;
- unredacted route PDFs/screenshots;
- GPX/KML traces.

If private evidence exists, summarize the behavioral result here instead.
